newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ryder System estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ryder System estimates cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co on Monday reduced its estimate for Ryder System Inc's earnings in the fourth quarter of 1996 to $0.35-$0.40 from $0.55 and its estimate for full-year earnings to $1.40 from $1.60.
-- Gruntal said the company met with analysts last week to "talk down" estimates for the fourth quarter to the $0.35-$0.40 range.

-- Ryder will also follow up the sale of its rental business and the potential sale of its auto carrier division with a restructuring charge of $215 million in the fourth quarter, or $1.70 a share, assuming a 35-percent tax credit, Gruntal said. Ryder expects the move to add $70 million, or $0.50 a share, to earnings in fiscal 1997.
-- Ryder leases trucks, tractors and trailers.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/8 Monday at 27-7/8.
